incident-bot: ALERT /streaming-decode p99 spike in us-west-2 · 2026-06-12T10:45:21Z · severity: high · service: runtime-decode · current_p99: 1.52s (SLO 0.9s)

samir (oncall): saw it, pinging runtime team. any customer-facing errors?
mira (runtime): looks like tail latency on decode path for trt8 + flashattn kernels after last rollout. p95 up too but p99 worse.
dan (engineer): rolling kernel version from 2.4.1 -> 2.4.2 last night on prod nodes? that was the window.
eli (sre): correlation with paging counters rising on affected hosts: vmstat shows increase in pgfaults and stall events on gpu memory manager.
katie (pm): any customer impact? which accounts saw errors or timeouts?
mira (runtime): no 5xxs, but streaming stalls — streaming proxies are hitting client-side timeouts for some long-running chats. a couple of power users reported degraded interactivity.
samir (oncall): ok, mitigation plan: 1) route streaming traffic for high-TAIL routes to a safer kernel variant, 2) roll back last kernel build on a small subset, 3) scale up amber pool to drain backlog.
dan (engineer): I can pin routing to kernel-compat-2.3.9 for canary traffic. patch command:
```bash
# set routing policy for model routes tagged streaming-heavy
redis-cli -h config-store HSET routes:streaming:kernel pinned kernel-compat-2.3.9
```
eli (sre): spinning up 6 nodes in amber pool now (estimated 4m). watching p99.
mira (runtime): I pushed a runtime flag to disable flashattn fallback on the decode hotpath: `DECODE_USE_FLASHATTN=false` for canary hosts.
katie (pm): Log note — customer alpha-inc reported >2s latency on 3 sessions. flagged for outreach if persists >30m.
incident-bot: Deploy started by dan (engineer) · job: route-pin-176905 · ETA: 2026-06-12T10:52:00Z
dan (engineer): route changes applied to 15% of streaming routes. monitoring p99 now.
eli (sre): p99 dropped from 1.52s -> 1.05s in canary subset. overall cluster still noisy because older nodes in region.
samir (oncall): good. keep canary for 15m then expand if stable. also notify customers team to prepare comms if we need longer maintenance.
mira (runtime): looking at kernel compileflags used in 2.4.2: `-O3 -ftree-vectorize -fno-fast-math` plus a linker patch for memory layout. suspect the linker change interacts with our allocator under high kv-cache churn.
dan (engineer): I can trigger a rollback job for a small ring: `deploy rollback --image=runtime:2.4.1 --ring=R13`
eli (sre): please hold rollback until we verify amber pool drain and routing expansion — rollback could cause pod restarts and transient errors.
katie (pm): ETA decisions? if we keep p99 >1s after 30m we escalate to SEV2 + customer notification.
incident-bot: Metric alert: streaming-decode p99 still >1.0s in us-west-2 for 7m · triggered at 2026-06-12T10:53:40Z
samir (oncall): expanding routing pin to 40% now (dan/eli). dan can you update runbook note with commands used?
dan (engineer): done — added commands and links to the kernel artifact. also pasted the `nvml` sample logs we saw:```
[2026-06-12T10:46:12Z] GPU0: page_faults=238, stalled_usec=12345
[2026-06-12T10:46:13Z] GPU1: page_faults=12, stalled_usec=110
```
mira (runtime): interesting: page_faults concentrated on GPU0 which runs chat-heavy workloads. switching that host to mem-pressure policy `--vm-alloc-mode=relax` reduced paging events in a lab repro.
eli (sre): can we temporarily de-schedule noisy tenants from those hosts? use k8s node taint: `kubectl taint nodes gpu0 noisy=true:NoSchedule`
dan (engineer): tainted node gpu0 and cordoned it. draining pods onto amber pool.
samir (oncall): please confirm no 5xxs.
mira (runtime): no 5xxs observed. streaming latency p99 in region reduced to 0.88s after 18m of mitigations.
katie (pm): thanks team. I'll open a customer ticket thread and flag alpha-inc for proactive outreach.
incident-bot: Handoff reminder: oncall next shift at 2026-06-12T11:15:00Z — include summary, mitigation, and open action items.
samir (oncall): Handoff summary for next oncall:
- Incident: streaming decode p99 spike in us-west-2 after runtime kernel 2.4.2 rollout
- Impact: streaming stalls, client timeouts for long-running sessions; no 5xxs; alpha-inc degraded UX (3 sessions)
- Mitigations applied: route-pin kernel-compat-2.3.9 -> 40%, disabled flashattn fallback on canaries, spun up amber pool + drained noisy node, node taint/drain on gpu0
- Observed effect: p99 from 1.52s -> 0.88s in 18m
- Open actions: (1) runtime to run artifact bisect to isolate linker change, (2) SRE to run nightly stress to repro paging, (3) PM to contact alpha-inc if >30m
- Next steps: consider rollback to 2.4.1 on a controlled ring if p99 rebounds

mira (runtime): I'll start bisect now, will post findings in this thread. attaching repro script link: https://stash/internal/repro-stream-paging
d an (engineer): correcting: dan (engineer) — pushed the rollback doc to runbook.
eli (sre): leaving monitoring on — will escalate immediately if p99 >1.2s again.
samir (oncall): thanks. handing off to next oncall. please keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
